en: Dependent on a state that is not a corruption, a state that is not a corruption arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is not a corruption, a state that is not a non-corruption arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is not a corruption, states that are both not a corruption and not a non-corruption arise by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is not a corruption, a state that is not a corruption arises by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is neither a corruption nor not a corruption, a state that is not a corruption arises by way of root condition … three. (Abbreviated.
Under root [condition] there are nine … pe … under resultant [condition] there is one … pe … under non-disappearance [condition] there are nine. (In all cases, nine.)
